← → ↑ ↓ move · Enter play · PgUp/PgDn change channelTap to choose · tap again to play. Esc leaves the preview.

  • Free software: read, build and change the code under GPL-3.0-or-later.
  • No analytics and no sign-up. The app talks to your provider, and to TMDB only if you turn it on.
  • Built in Rust. Provider text is drawn as text and never run as code.
  • Passwords and playlist links live in Windows Credential Manager, never in files or logs.
  • Films and series load per category, so a big catalogue never blocks the screen.
  • Arrows and Enter everywhere, a TV mode for the sofa, and full mouse support.

opensmarters ships with no channels, content or provider. Use it with a subscription you're entitled to. Independent open-source project, not affiliated with IPTV Smarters or WHMCS Smarters. LicenceSecuritySource
